summary_1line: Ravana carries Sita to Lanka; she drops jewels as clues, is imprisoned under guard, and Ravana sends demons to spy on and prepare vengeance against Rama.

image_candidates.scene_text: As Ravana flies through the sky clutching Sita, she secretly drops her golden cloak and jewels toward five monkeys on a mountain peak below.
Ravana strides into the golden city of Lanka carrying the struggling Sita in his arms while celestial beings in the sky whisper that his end is near.
In the inner chambers of Lanka’s palace, the grief-stricken Sita stands surrounded by fearsome demon women as Ravana commands them to guard her.
